rationale: Create one USIC utility-network-protection platform. Partners Group acquired control in November 2017 and sold 50% to a Kohlberg-led consortium on November 10, 2022, retaining a 50% co-lead interest. USIC currently confirms the same 50/50 ownership. Preserve the earlier Kohlberg, OMERS Private Equity and Leonard Green periods without splitting holding entities, affiliates or acquired locators.

afterImage.subsector: Underground utility network protection and locating services
afterImage.description: USIC, LLC is a U.S. utility-network-protection platform providing public and private utility locating, geographic-information-system services, gas and water infrastructure services, inspections, cross-bore programs and vacuum excavation. Headquartered in Indianapolis, the company operates in 48 states, serves more than 1,400 utility and telecommunications customers and performs more than 80 million annual locates with over 10,000 employees. Partners Group acquired control in November 2017 and, on November 10, 2022, sold 50% to a Kohlberg-led consortium while retaining a 50% co-lead interest. USIC currently confirms the same 50/50 ownership. Earlier Kohlberg, OMERS Private Equity and Leonard Green ownership periods are preserved. Holding companies, financing entities, affiliates, regions, customers, utilities and 811 centers are not separate PortCos. No later sale or signed pending ownership transfer was identified through September 1, 2026.
